attributes.name: sidebar list item structure
attributes.definition: How items in sidebar/secondary lists (e.g. recent or popular posts) are composed.

values.definition: Each row combines a small thumbnail with a title and date metadata.
Rows contain text only, with no thumbnail or media.
Rows are led by prominent ranking numerals.

attributes.name: list row separator
attributes.definition: How adjacent rows in a list are visually separated.

values.definition: Each row sits in its own box or card.
Rows separated by whitespace without lines.

attributes.name: ranking numeral treatment
attributes.definition: How rank numbers in a popular or ranked list are styled.

values.definition: Oversized numerals in an accent colour.
Numbers placed inside circles or badges.
Ranked list has no numbers or none present.

attributes.name: tag cloud chip style
attributes.definition: Shape and fill of tag chips used in a tag cloud or tag list.

values.definition: Fully rounded chips with a border and no fill.
Fully rounded chips with solid fill.
Rectangular chips with small corner radius.
Tags shown as unstyled text links.
